picks.rationale_en: We read Western Digital as one to accumulate on the medium-to-long horizon — composite score 63/100, 68% confidence. Above all, revenue growing 44% YoY. That said, realized volatility 100% (annualised). We'd step back if a daily close below the 50-day MA (~540.53).

reasons: EPS estimates revised up (12 up vs 1 down, 30d).

Negative earnings-estimate revisions or a guidance cut.
A shift in the broad market to a risk-off / correction state.
